finalText:
All 13 passengers on AA918 are re-protected and have been notified. No change fees or fare differences were charged, and no bulletins were in effect. I did not resolve any queue requests, since the task didn't name any.

| Reservation | Passenger | New itinerary | Compensation |
|---|---|---|---|
| R6103 | Chloe Park (platinum) | Business, UA88, Aug 3, arrives 12:25 | None |
| R6109 | Iris Vance (platinum) | UA88, Aug 3, arrives 12:25, moved up to premium economy | None |
| R6106 | Farid Haddad (gold) | Basic economy, UA88, Aug 3, arrives 12:25 | None |
| R6110, R6111 | Jun Takeda and Kofi Mensah (travelling together) | Economy, AA204, Aug 3, arrives 15:15, kept together and not upgraded | None |
| R6112 | Lea Sorensen (gold) | AA204, Aug 3, arrives 15:15, moved up to business | None |
| R6105 | Elena Fox | Basic economy, AA204, Aug 3, arrives 15:15 | None |
| R6102 | Ben Okafor (gold) | Economy, DL512, Aug 3, arrives 18:40 | $150 compensation voucher (about 5 hours later) |
| R6108 | Hugo Brandt (silver) | Economy, AA210, Aug 3, arrives 23:50 | $300 compensation voucher |
| R6104 | Dev Mehta (silver) | Economy, AA210 Aug 3, then AA1410 ORD to BOS Aug 4, arrives 12:25 | $300 compensation voucher and $180 hotel voucher |
| R6113 | Mo Farah (silver) | Same as Dev | $300 compensation voucher and $180 hotel voucher |
| R6107 | Grace Liu | Economy, AA206, Aug 4, arrives 15:15 | $240 compensation voucher and $180 hotel voucher |
| R6101 | Ana Ruiz | Economy, AA206, Aug 4, arrives 15:15 | $300 compensation voucher and $180 hotel voucher |

- **Upgrades:** Iris and Lea are the only passengers moved up a cabin. Both are platinum or gold, travelling alone on one flight, with their own cabin full on a flight that gets them there sooner.
- **Connections:** Dev and Mo's original connection (AA1402) could not be kept, because no economy seat on any flight reaching ORD in time was left for them after higher-priority passengers. I rebooked their onward leg onto AA1410 the next morning.
- **Grace's voucher:** Her compensation is $240 rather than $300, because a voucher can't exceed the fare paid.
- **Payment instrument:** R6104 (Dev) has no payment instrument on file. That didn't matter, because only vouchers were issued and no money was refunded to a payment method.
